isolation_method: by instruction and brief design. One drafter attempt was run by the orchestrator as a headless CLI call in restricted mode with no tools, no MCP servers, no skills and no session persistence, from an otherwise empty working directory outside the repository; project instructions were not loaded. Residual exposure: the prompt hash verifies the prompt bytes only, the CLI built-in default system prompt was in effect, and isolation is claimed only by instruction and brief design, not by a technical guarantee.
statement: An AI agent drafted these proposals and holds no EMS authority. The proposals bind nothing until they are decided by the EMS governance authority.
